home-page.title: Find an archival file online ― easily!
home-page.description: Duck Inspector is a search service that allows you to find an archive file online. Just enter the details of the archive, fund, description, and file and get a link to the source.

process.title: How it works
process.subtitle: Duck Inspector doesn't store the archives — it watches where they already live and gives you one door in.

publish.title: Archives publish scans
publish.description: State archives and partner platforms digitize case files and put them online, each on its own site.

index.title: Duck Inspector indexes them
index.description: We track every source continuously and match up archives, funds and descriptions across all of them.

search.title: You search once
search.description: Type a name or a case, and get a direct link to wherever the scan actually lives.

stats.title: By the numbers
stats.subtitle: A snapshot of everything Duck Inspector has indexed, taken at the last build.
stats.checkedLast7Days: Online copies checked in the last 7 days
stats.communityEditsLast7Days: Community edits applied in the last 7 days

daily-updates-page.title: Daily Report
daily-updates-page.description: A list of new archive files found online in the last 24 hours.
daily-updates-page.limit-note: The maximum number of findings is limited to 25,000.

search-input.label: Enter the file details:
search-input.hint: Use * for any number of characters and _ for a single character

metadata.title: Duck Inspector ― search for Ukrainian archive files online
metadata.description: A service for searching Ukrainian archive files available online. Enter the file details in a simple search window and get a link to the source.
metadata.fund-description: Search for files online in the fund {archiveCode}-{fundCode}{fundTitle} / archive {archiveCode} fund {fundCode} / {archiveCode} f.{fundCode}
metadata.description-description: Search for files online in the description {archiveCode}-{fundCode}-{descriptionCode}{descriptionTitle} / archive {archiveCode} fund {fundCode} description {descriptionCode} / {archiveCode} f.{fundCode}, d.{descriptionCode}
metadata.case-description: File online {archiveCode}-{fundCode}-{descriptionCode}-{caseCode}{caseTitle} / archive {archiveCode} fund {fundCode} description {descriptionCode} file {caseCode} / {archiveCode} f.{fundCode}, d.{descriptionCode}, c.{caseCode}

donation-modal.body-1: Duck Inspector is a volunteer project with no source of funding. Everything you see on this site is provided to users absolutely free of charge.
donation-modal.body-2: Regular and steady donations help pay for the services needed to keep the site running.

report-form.title: Report an error
report-form.step-tree-hint: The record is in the wrong archive, fond, or inventory, or has a wrong code.
report-form.step-copy-hint: The link is broken, points elsewhere, or is missing.
report-form.step-data-hint: The title, description or years are wrong.
report-form.step-authors-hint: The church, registry office, court, or other institution that created the record.
report-form.step-text-question: Describe the problem in your own words
report-form.tree-unchanged-hint: Pick a different location or change the code.
report-form.copy-url-hint: If the link you mean is not in the list, paste it here.
report-form.data-no-changes-hint: Change at least one field to continue.
report-form.text-placeholder: Describe the error — for example: wrong year, typo in the title
report-form.error-already-pending: A report on this record is already awaiting review
report-form.error-unauthorized: Sign in to send a report

search-guide.format-intro: Enter the reference code in this format:
search-guide.scope-title: Search works on reference codes only
search-guide.scope-p1: Duck Inspector does not aim to catalog the files themselves — it is built solely to check whether files are available online at various sources. It therefore collects nothing beyond the files' reference codes.
search-guide.scope-p2: To find a file's reference code by place, time period, or title, use the archives' own catalogs or other resources, for example:
search-guide.letters-p1: Enter all lettered codes in capital letters, without spaces or dashes.
search-guide.partial-p1: For a partial search, skip the unknown part of the code, for example:
search-guide.symbols-p1: Use Cyrillic letters, digits, and dashes. Latin letters are converted to Cyrillic automatically (DAKHMO → ДАХмО).
